links.outcome: Flesch-Kincaid grade level of AI medication counseling under default vs sixth-grade prompts
links.effect: Pooled default AI FKGL 12.19 ± 4.85 vs sixth-grade-prompted 7.63 ± 3.16; prompting lowered FKGL across all three models (all P ≤ 0.001).
links.quote: The average pooled default AI FKGL was 12.19 ± 4.85, while the pooled sixth-grade AI FKGL was 7.63 ± 3.16.

links.outcome: Reading grade level of AI and website medication information relative to low-literacy patients
links.effect: Default AI FKGL 12.19 ± 4.85 and websites 10.49 ± 3.95 (Mann-Whitney U = 343.0, P = 0.31), well above a sixth-grade level.
links.quote: The AI-generated medication counseling passages in this sample frequently exhibited a higher FKGL than the aggregated website passages

screen.reason: Evaluates readability of LLM-generated patient medication counseling and tests the impact of adding sixth-grade reading level prompt constraints versus default generation.
